name: Griseus
source:
Do you remember?

You are Gray, a coyote who you will learn about over the course of the story. He has been given a chance to restart, but it doesn't come simply. A troubled youth and conflicting feelings leaves Gray more introverted than before.

What will you discover about Gray, the people you meet, and the event that separated Gray from his friends and family? Perhaps even from himself...

[From [url=https://rysaea.itch.io/griseus]Itch.io[/url]]
